proof_assumption: Valid independently checked owner proof where a case says valid; fixtures provide no proof.

cases.given: All signed task terms are supported and rendered; current revision and pinned-key proof are valid.
Valid Stytch/Dot login without an independent owner decision.
Request carries execution terms that the current generic page does not render.
Client or consumer cannot interpret the task intent version.
Request body or budget changes while the old signed request digest is reused.
Unchanged signed board request refers to r1; current authoritative task is r2.
The exact valid signed reply closed the board request; no withdrawal/supersession/previous effect exists.
A withdrawal, supersession or different decision closed the request.
Same answer_id and operation intent already reserved or admitted.
Same answer_id now points at different task/effect bytes.
Decision/key/task grant expired or was revoked before effect admission.
Decision is reject, defer or ask.
Approve includes a material condition not represented in typed task bounds.
Any nonempty signed approve comment, even apparently harmless prose, in the first writable profile.
Native entry may have occurred, but its acknowledgment was lost.
Required aggregate reservation or spend coverage is unavailable.
